_comment: Soundtrack spec for AG Racer. Tags drive ACE-Step: a SHORT flat comma-separated list, not prose - long lists dilute the tempo and genre signal. Lead with genre and BPM. Do NOT use negative tags ('no guitars'): the model has no negation, so naming a thing conditions it IN. Use lyrics=[inst] (omit the `lyrics` field) for instrumentals instead. Direction: fast breakbeat, strong melody, sense of speed. Everything is 170+ bpm - mid-tempo does not feel fast behind a 340 km/h ship.
